newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 50 bln dong T-notes, rate 12.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 50 bln dong T-notes, rate 12.0 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 50 billion dong ($4.29 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 12.0 percent to domestic institutions at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last auction of government paper, on May 14, the central bank sold 50 billion dong worth of one-year notes, also at a rate of 12.0 percent.
The issue date of the notes sold on Wednesday is May 23 and maturity will be on May 23, 1998.
The bank said allotments of stock, in dong, were as follows:
Industrial and Commercial Bank of Vietnam 42.3 billion
Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam 1.7 billion
